verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a developer-facing Git client, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no CLI. The automation surfaces it does document are Shortcuts, x-callback-url, the built-in WebDAV server and the in-app Repository Agent, which are different capabilities and earn no credit here. The SSH commands mentioned run on remote servers to list repositories, not as a Working Copy CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
